hypotheses.C1_global_fisher_beats_identity: Global-full exceeds identity by at least 0.10 median oracle-effect fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.C2_global128_beats_random128: Global rank-128 exceeds random rank-128 by at least 0.10 oracle-effect fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.C3_fisher_eigenvalues_add_value: Global rank-128 exceeds its unweighted rank-128 projector by at least 0.05 oracle-effect fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.C4_fisher_direction_weight_pairing_matte: Global-full exceeds eigenvalue-shuffled full by at least 0.10 oracle-effect fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.C5_global_metric_is_not_only_generic_imp: Global-full has both higher oracle-effect fidelity and higher held-out oracle-objective efficiency than identity on both corpora.
